{{Quote|But sir, the ships are still attached.|The B1 battle droid, to General Grievous|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
This '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' participated in the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]]. After being ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], he opened fire on a [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic light cruiser]] before telling his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to board a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]].
